newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ yields drift lower at close in thin market.
newsitem.headline: NZ yields drift lower at close in thin market.

text.p: Figures in brackets compare against previous day's close
* NZ yields drift lower at close, helped by U.S. Treasuries
* Volumes better than expected given shortened trading week
* Next focus inflation data due on January 17
New Zealand mid and short bond yields rallied slightly in thin Monday trade, helped by a stronger U.S. Treasury market and some year-end book dressing.
"In a thin market it's not that hard to drive it if you're prepared to buy a little bit here and there -- there are not a lot of people to stand in your way," one dealer said.
The 02/00 bond closed three points lower in yield at 6.99 percent, while the 11/06 was down four at 7.19 percent.
The money market closed largely unchanged.

Dealers said volumes had been better than expected but were still very quiet, with trading sandwiched between the Christmas and New Year breaks. Flows are expected to remain minimal for another week, picking up next Monday as traders returned from holidays and began looking ahead to key inflation data on January 17.
